_note: ITD District 4 screening catalogue: corridor types commute, recreational, retail (ROADMAP Item 66), each generated by inrix_tools.extents.generate_catalogue on its own windows (cores on recurring congestion against each segment's own baseline, Item 50), merged by extents.merge_typed_catalogues; couplets by inrix_tools.couplets.detect_couplets. Item 46/49 predecessor in legacy/item46_catalogues/; the separate 2026-09-29 recreational catalogues in legacy/rec_catalogues_2026-09-29/.

thresholds.baseline: night mean with >= 100 gated obs, else weekday_tt_p15

recreational.name: recreational

retail.name: retail
